items.title: Kyiv mayor reports damage to three bridges after Russian strikes
items.summary: Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko reported damage to the Podilsko-Voskresenskyi and Darnytskyi bridges and hits on the Southern Bridge during Russian missile strikes. Cross-river traffic was restricted, and he urged residents to avoid unnecessary driving while authorities assessed the damage.

items.title: Poland says Russian athlete visa ban will feature in EU sanctions proposal
items.summary: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said a ban on issuing visas to Russian athletes would be included in the proposed 22nd EU sanctions package. The measure remains a proposal rather than an enacted EU-wide restriction.
